connects_to.relationship: CW laser sources and CPO solutions (high-power CW laser, ELS modules, fiber attach units) under multiyear supply agreement; NVIDIA made $2B equity investment in Coherent

contracts.signal: Coherent's 10-K: during fiscal 2026 it entered into a strategic multi-year supply agreement with NVIDIA for advanced lasers and optical networking products supporting next-generation AI infrastructure; the non-exclusive March 2, 2026 agreement covers manufacturing capacity and R&D and includes a multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment with NVIDIA, as well as future access and capacity rights for advanced laser and optical networking products.
